tasks_completed.description: FIX-1: add() guard rejects time.end === '00:00' and uses numeric timeToMinutes comparison for zero-duration
tasks_completed.changes: Added `item.time.end !== '00:00'` sentinel check and replaced string equality `start !== end` with `timeToMinutes(start) !== timeToMinutes(end)` to handle format variations like '9:00' vs '09:00'
tasks_completed.rationale: Root cause: add() checked start!='00:00' but not end, allowing degenerate midnight-sentinel entries through; string equality missed numerically-equal but differently-formatted times

tasks_completed.description: FIX-2: Dedup key includes stable name identifier to prevent over-deduplication of distinct optional items
tasks_completed.changes: Dedup key changed from `slot:type` to `slot:type:name` where name = `e.name_base || e.title || e._label || ''`
tasks_completed.rationale: Root cause: key used only type+slot, causing two different optional activities at the same time (e.g., 'Dim Sum' vs 'Noodles' both optional at 08:00-09:00) to be collapsed into one

tasks_completed.description: FIX-3: firstH has NaN fallback via `|| 8`
tasks_completed.changes: Changed `parseInt(...)` to `parseInt(...) || 8` so a corrupt or missing time.start does not propagate NaN into all pixel calculations
tasks_completed.rationale: Root cause: parseInt on malformed string returns NaN; NaN propagates through hH arithmetic producing invisible timeline

tasks_completed.description: FIX-4: lastH computed from max(time.end) across all entries, not last entry's start+2
tasks_completed.changes: lastH now uses `Math.min(Math.max(...entriesWithLayout.map(e => parseInt(e.time.end) || (parseInt(e.time.start) + 1) || 9)), 24)` instead of last-entry-start + 2
tasks_completed.rationale: Root cause: a 3-hour dinner starting at 20:00 (ending 23:00) would clip its last hour since lastH was capped at 22 (20+2)

tasks_completed.description: FIX-5: top() return value clamped to Math.max(0, ...) to prevent negative pixel offsets
tasks_completed.changes: Wrapped top() return in `Math.max(0, ...)` to ensure no entry is positioned above the grid top
tasks_completed.rationale: Root cause: if a stray entry slips through with start < firstH (e.g., via direct push bypassing add()), top() produces a negative pixel value rendering the entry above the visible grid

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A - logic gaps in code added during current session (2026-04-05 to 2026-04-06)
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Filters were added incrementally to handle specific known cases without a systematic audit of all degenerate input combinations: end sentinel not checked, dedup key too coarse, lastH reads start not end, NaN not guarded
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Five independent in-place fixes each address their specific gap: sentinel check, numeric comparison, name-keyed dedup, max(end) for lastH, and pixel clamping
